ingredients.name: palm oil
ingredients.summary: Palm oil is a common cooking and processing fat high in saturated fat. Excess intake of saturated fat may negatively affect heart health.
ingredients.details: Health impact depends on overall diet and whether the oil is refined; refined palm oil can also contain processing contaminants in small amounts. Environmental and sustainability concerns are also associated with palm oil production.

ingredients.name: canola oil
ingredients.summary: Canola oil is a vegetable oil relatively low in saturated fat and high in unsaturated fats. It is generally considered a heart‑healthier option among common cooking oils.
ingredients.details: Refined canola oil is highly processed but current evidence does not show harm at typical dietary intakes. It is often used for frying and in processed foods.

ingredients.name: soy lecithin
ingredients.summary: Soy lecithin is an emulsifier used to keep ingredients mixed and improve texture. It is generally recognized as safe in the amounts used in foods.
ingredients.details: It contains small amounts of phospholipids and may contain trace soy protein, which can matter for people with severe soy allergy. Typical amounts are very low.

ingredients.name: wheat flour
ingredients.summary: Wheat flour is a refined grain ingredient that provides carbohydrates and some protein. It is unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.
ingredients.details: Refined wheat flour is lower in fiber and micronutrients than whole‑grain flour and can contribute to rapid blood sugar increases when eaten in large amounts.

ingredients.name: sugar
ingredients.summary: Sugar is added for sweetness and can contribute to excess calorie intake. High intake of added sugars is linked to weight gain and metabolic issues.
ingredients.details: Repeated appearances of sugar in the list suggest the product may be relatively high in added sugars, which can affect blood glucose and dental health.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.summary: Salt (sodium chloride) is used for flavor and preservation. High sodium intake is associated with increased blood pressure and cardiovascular risk.
ingredients.details: This ingredient appears many times, suggesting the product may be high in sodium, which is a concern for people with hypertension or kidney disease.

ingredients.name: corn starch
ingredients.summary: Corn starch is a refined carbohydrate used as a thickener and texture agent. It is generally safe for most people.
ingredients.details: It is low in fiber and nutrients and can raise blood sugar when consumed in large amounts, but typical additive amounts are modest.

ingredients.name: spices
ingredients.summary: Spices are used for flavor and typically provide small amounts of beneficial plant compounds. They are generally safe.
ingredients.details: The exact spices are not specified, which may matter for individuals with specific spice allergies or intolerances.

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.summary: Garlic is a seasoning ingredient that can provide flavor and some beneficial sulfur compounds. It is safe for most people.
ingredients.details: Some individuals may experience digestive discomfort or have sensitivity to garlic, especially in larger amounts.

ingredients.name: whole milk powder
ingredients.summary: Whole milk powder is dehydrated whole milk containing lactose, milk proteins, and milk fat. It is unsuitable for people with milk allergy or lactose intolerance.
ingredients.details: It contributes saturated fat and calories and appears multiple times, indicating a notable dairy component in the product.

ingredients.name: skim milk powder
ingredients.summary: Skim milk powder is dehydrated non‑fat milk that provides protein, lactose, and minerals with little fat. It is not suitable for those with milk allergy or lactose intolerance.
ingredients.details: It can improve texture and protein content but still contains lactose and milk proteins that can trigger reactions in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: caramel color
ingredients.summary: Caramel color is a common coloring additive used to give a brown hue. It is generally recognized as safe but some types may contain trace by‑products.
ingredients.details: Certain manufacturing processes can form compounds like 4‑MEI in small amounts; regulatory agencies set limits, but some consumers prefer to limit intake of colored soft drinks and heavily colored foods.

ingredients.name: monosodium glutamate
ingredients.summary: Monosodium glutamate (MSG) is a flavor enhancer that boosts umami taste. It is considered safe for the general population at typical intake levels.
ingredients.details: A small subset of people report sensitivity symptoms, though controlled studies have not consistently confirmed this; those individuals may choose to avoid it.

ingredients.name: defatted soybean
ingredients.summary: Defatted soybean is a soy protein source with most of the fat removed. It is a common plant protein ingredient.
ingredients.details: It is a potential allergen for people with soy allergy and may be processed, but it can contribute useful protein content.

ingredients.name: yeast extract
ingredients.summary: Yeast extract is a flavoring ingredient rich in natural glutamates that enhance savory taste. It is generally safe for most people.
ingredients.details: It can be an issue for individuals who are sensitive to glutamates or who need to restrict dietary purines, but typical amounts are small.

ingredients.name: natural and artificial flavors
ingredients.summary: Natural and artificial flavors are added to enhance or create taste. Their exact composition is not disclosed.
ingredients.details: They are regulated for safety, but the lack of specificity can be problematic for people with certain allergies, sensitivities, or those wishing to avoid synthetic additives.

ingredients.name: honey
ingredients.summary: Honey is a natural sweetener composed mainly of sugars. It contributes calories and sweetness.
ingredients.details: It has a similar metabolic impact to other sugars and should be limited for blood sugar control; it is unsafe for infants under one year due to botulism risk, though in processed foods risk is very low.

ingredients.name: dextrin
ingredients.summary: Dextrin is a carbohydrate derived from starch used as a filler, thickener, or carrier. It is generally safe.
ingredients.details: It is quickly digested to glucose and can raise blood sugar, but amounts used as an additive are usually modest.

ingredients.name: pasteurized milk
ingredients.summary: Pasteurized milk is heat‑treated milk used as a dairy base. It contains lactose and milk proteins.
ingredients.details: It is unsuitable for people with milk allergy or lactose intolerance and contributes saturated fat depending on fat level (not specified here).

ingredients.name: cheese cultures
ingredients.summary: Cheese cultures are beneficial bacteria used to ferment milk and develop cheese flavor. They are generally safe.
ingredients.details: They contribute to flavor and texture; people with dairy allergy react to the milk proteins, not the cultures themselves.

ingredients.name: enzymes
ingredients.summary: Enzymes are proteins used to modify texture or aid in cheese making. They are typically present in very small amounts.
ingredients.details: They are usually safe, though their source (animal, microbial, or plant) is not specified, which may matter for strict vegetarians or people with rare enzyme sensitivities.

ingredients.name: onion flake
ingredients.summary: Onion flake is dehydrated onion used for flavor. It is safe for most people.
ingredients.details: Some individuals with FODMAP sensitivity or onion allergy may experience digestive symptoms or reactions.

ingredients.name: natural flavor
ingredients.summary: Natural flavor is a broad term for flavoring substances derived from natural sources. The exact ingredients are not specified.
ingredients.details: This lack of detail can be an issue for people with allergies or sensitivities to certain plants, spices, or animal‑derived flavorings.

ingredients.name: onion extract
ingredients.summary: Onion extract is a concentrated flavoring derived from onion. It is generally safe.
ingredients.details: It may trigger symptoms in people with onion allergy or FODMAP sensitivity, but amounts are usually small.

ingredients.name: soy sauce (soybean, wheat, salt)
ingredients.summary: Soy sauce is a fermented seasoning made from soybeans, wheat, and salt. It is high in sodium and contains common allergens.
ingredients.details: It is unsuitable for people with soy or wheat/gluten allergy and can significantly contribute to sodium intake.

ingredients.name: garlic extract
ingredients.summary: Garlic extract is a concentrated garlic flavoring. It is safe for most people.
ingredients.details: It may cause digestive discomfort or reactions in individuals sensitive or allergic to garlic.

ingredients.name: tomato powder
ingredients.summary: Tomato powder is dehydrated tomato used for flavor and color. It is generally safe.
ingredients.details: It may be an issue for people with tomato allergy or those sensitive to acidic foods, but typical amounts are modest.

ingredients.name: dried onion
ingredients.summary: Dried onion is dehydrated onion used as a seasoning. It is safe for most people.
ingredients.details: As with other onion forms, it can trigger symptoms in individuals with onion allergy or FODMAP sensitivity.

ingredients.name: glucose
ingredients.summary: Glucose is a simple sugar used as a sweetener and texturizer. It can rapidly raise blood sugar levels.
ingredients.details: Frequent or high intake can contribute to metabolic issues, especially in people with insulin resistance or diabetes.

ingredients.name: sucrose fatty acid esters
ingredients.summary: Sucrose fatty acid esters are emulsifiers used to blend fats and water. They are generally recognized as safe.
ingredients.details: They are present in small amounts and not a significant nutrient source; some people prefer to limit emulsifiers due to emerging gut microbiome research, though evidence is not conclusive.

ingredients.name: dextrose anhydrous glucose
ingredients.summary: Dextrose anhydrous is a form of glucose used as a sweetener and energy source. It has a high glycemic index.
ingredients.details: It can quickly raise blood sugar and insulin levels, which is a concern for people with diabetes or metabolic syndrome when consumed in large amounts.

ingredients.name: banana
ingredients.summary: Banana is a fruit ingredient that adds flavor and natural sugars. It is generally safe and provides some nutrients.
ingredients.details: It may be an allergen for a small number of people and contributes carbohydrates and natural sugars to the product.

ingredients.name: processed honey
ingredients.summary: Processed honey is refined or heat‑treated honey used as a sweetener. It behaves similarly to other added sugars metabolically.
ingredients.details: Processing can reduce some natural enzymes and compounds; it should still be limited for blood sugar control and overall added sugar intake.

ingredients.name: tomato paste
ingredients.summary: Tomato paste is concentrated tomato used for flavor and color. It is generally safe and can provide some antioxidants like lycopene.
ingredients.details: It may cause issues for people with tomato allergy or acid reflux when consumed in large amounts.

ingredients.name: fermented milk
ingredients.summary: Fermented milk is a dairy product cultured with beneficial bacteria. It still contains milk proteins and lactose (amount varies).
ingredients.details: It may be easier to digest for some lactose‑sensitive individuals but remains unsuitable for those with true milk allergy.

ingredients.name: citric acid
ingredients.summary: Citric acid is an acidulant used to add tartness and act as a preservative. It is generally recognized as safe.
ingredients.details: Rarely, some individuals report sensitivity or mouth irritation, but typical food levels are well tolerated.

ingredients.name: mono- and diglycerides
ingredients.summary: Mono- and diglycerides are emulsifiers derived from fats used to improve texture and shelf life. They can contain small amounts of trans fats depending on source.
ingredients.details: They are present in small amounts but contribute to the overall intake of processed fat; source (plant or animal) is not specified, which may matter for some dietary preferences.

ingredients.name: Alkali
ingredients.summary: Alkali refers to basic (high pH) substances used to adjust acidity or modify texture and flavor in foods.
ingredients.details: Common food alkalis include sodium carbonate or potassium carbonate; they are generally recognized as safe but may be unsuitable for people needing to strictly limit sodium or certain minerals.

ingredients.name: Tomato extract
ingredients.summary: Tomato extract is a concentrated form of tomato used for flavor and color, containing natural antioxidants like lycopene.
ingredients.details: It is generally safe and can contribute beneficial plant compounds, though people with tomato allergy should avoid it.

ingredients.name: Soy protein hydrolysate
ingredients.summary: Soy protein hydrolysate is soy protein broken down into smaller peptides and amino acids, used to enhance flavor and protein content.
ingredients.details: It is a common source of hidden glutamates and is unsuitable for people with soy allergy; otherwise generally safe for most consumers.

ingredients.name: Apple puree
ingredients.summary: Apple puree is mashed or processed apple used for sweetness, flavor, and texture.
ingredients.details: It provides natural sugars and some fiber and is generally safe, though people with apple allergy or fructose intolerance may need to avoid it.

ingredients.name: Dried garlic
ingredients.summary: Dried garlic is dehydrated garlic used as a seasoning.
ingredients.details: It is generally safe and may have beneficial compounds, but can cause digestive discomfort or allergic reactions in sensitive people.

ingredients.name: Maltose
ingredients.summary: Maltose is a disaccharide sugar often derived from starch, used as a sweetener.
ingredients.details: Like other sugars, high intake can contribute to blood sugar spikes, dental caries, and excess calorie consumption.

ingredients.name: Whey powder
ingredients.summary: Whey powder is a dairy-derived protein and lactose source made from the liquid portion of milk.
ingredients.details: It is high in milk proteins and lactose, making it unsuitable for people with milk allergy and potentially problematic for those with lactose intolerance.

ingredients.name: Garlic flake
ingredients.summary: Garlic flake is sliced, dried garlic used as a seasoning.
ingredients.details: It is generally safe and similar in properties to dried garlic, with possible digestive or allergic issues only in sensitive individuals.

ingredients.name: Paprika color
ingredients.summary: Paprika color is a natural colorant derived from paprika peppers, providing red to orange hues.
ingredients.details: It is usually well tolerated, though people with pepper or paprika allergy should avoid it.

ingredients.name: Disodium inosinate
ingredients.summary: Disodium inosinate is a flavor enhancer often used with MSG to intensify umami taste.
ingredients.details: It is generally safe at typical levels but may be of concern for people trying to avoid added flavor enhancers or those who report sensitivity to such additives.
